## Description
  The best non-polluted method involves non-phosgene process by producing &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;diphenyl carbonate (DPC) from carbon dioxide (CO₂) and ethylene oxide (EO). &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;It avoids the use of highly toxic phosgene while utilizing EO production as &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;a raw material.&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;This approach significantly reduces environmental and health risks, generates fewer &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;emissions, and produces water and carbon monoxide as by-products instead of hazardous waste.&#10;&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;The process is considered more environmentally friendly, with lower acidification &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;potential and reduced energy consumption compared to the phosgene method.&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;
